data_protocol.task: supervised initial field to one fixed future time
data_protocol.spatial_policy: point subsampling, no filtering; same grid for every model
data_protocol.physics_note: supervised only; upstream generator diffusion uses epsilon/pi

baseline_note: No fitted hyperparameters; mean-field baseline uses training targets only.
limitations: One PDE, one target time, one subset split, five training seeds.
Equal optimizer updates are not equal parameter count or compute.
Projection uses held-out labels offline and relaxed per-sample bias.
No significance, physics-informed, generalization-to-resolution or SOTA claim.
